onlyRecorderTransform: The fixed private root declaration is replaced in memory by const repo = process.cwd(); the shared source is never edited.
rawStreams: Original stdout/stderr bytes are gzip archived separately; no path, newline, Unicode or stream normalization is applied to saved bytes.
nestedEnvironment: NODE_TEST_CONTEXT and NODE_V8_COVERAGE are removed before nested Node startup. Optional subject/selectors are removed, never set to empty paths.
